'''Va Gobolungnum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was affiliated with the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Gobolungnum authored a passage on the various affiliate guilds and chapters of the Bounty Hunters' Guild for inclusion in the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]].<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
